name: Unclaimed
source:
Unclaimed is a dark fantasy otome about desire, safety, and the cost of belonging.

Lost in a beautiful, dangerous realm, you must choose how to navigate being the mortal obsession of two powerful men, each offering a different kind of love.

Aemon promises protection and devotion. A life without difficult decisions.

Caius promises freedom and pleasure. A life without rules or restraint.

Both insist they can give you exactly what you need, but neither will choose for you.

There are no happy endings here.

[From [url=https://infinitestars.itch.io/unclaimed]Itch.io[/url]]
